description: Use this tool for federal ADMINISTRATIVE PRACTICE (Verwaltungspraxis): Wegleitungen, Kreisschreiben, Weisungen, Rundschreiben — agency guidance, not court decisions. 11,700+ documents: BSV (AHV/IV/EL/EO/FamZ/BVG Wegleitungen, Kreisschreiben, Mitteilungen, every version), OAK BV (BVG Weisungen, Mitteilungen), WEKO (Bekanntmachungen, Erläuterungen), SECO (ArG commentary, AVIG-Praxis), BAG (KVG), SEM (Weisungen, Handbuch Asyl), BJ + cantons (SchKG, Existenzminimum; canton=), FINMA, ESTV, BAFU; company law: UEK, RAB, EHRA, Stiftungsaufsicht. Also UN texts: recommendations to Switzerland (source='un_uhri': concluding observations, UPR, SPT, special procedures) and treaty-body General Comments (source='un_gc'). Returns ranked excerpts. Superseded versions collapse to the newest; for past conduct pass include_superseded=true. NOT covered: cantonal Sozialhilfe/SKOS, Prämienverbilligung — say so. UN complaint decisions: search_decisions(court='untb_*'). VPB/JAAC 1987–2017: search_decisions(court='ch_vb').

canton.description: Restrict to one canton's documents: its SchKG supervisory authority's circulars and Existenzminimum guideline (schkg_kantone, older copies in bj_schkg) and, for GE, VD and BE, its commercial register's practice notes (hr_kantone). KBKS = the national conference of enforcement officials.

doc_type.description: Filter by document type. wegleitung (SECO ArG 1,102 + BSV WEL/RWL…), rundschreiben (FINMA 1,017 + BSV/SEM), vollzugshilfe (297), kreisschreiben (ESTV 285 + BSV/BAG/BJ), rundschreiben_anhang (132 — FINMA circular annexes), mwst_branchen_info (84), weisung (SEM/SECO-ALV/BJ/BSV), mwst_info (69), handbuch (SEM Handbuch Asyl), mitteilung (BSV Mitteilungen an die Ausgleichskassen), nachtrag (BSV Nachträge), rechtsprechung (BSV AHI-Praxis digests), richtlinie (BJ, WEKO Richtlinien), weisung_anhang (BJ; OAK BV Informationsschreiben/FAQ), konkordat / erlass (BJ SchKG page), bekanntmachung / erlaeuterung (WEKO), entwurf (OAK BV Anhörungen: drafts, not in force), concluding_observations (UN treaty bodies), upr_recommendation (UN UPR), visit_report (UN SPT + special procedures), general_comment / general_recommendation (UN treaty bodies, un_gc), country_guidance (UNHCR), formular (BJ SchKG model forms; model statutes and deeds), bericht (BJ SchKG reports and studies; UEK/RAB/ESA annual reports), merkblatt (foundation supervisors, BE commercial register), faq (ESA FAQ).

include_superseded.description: Return every retained version of a document (FINMA, BSV) instead of collapsing to the newest. Set for point-in-time questions.

issuing_authority.description: Filter by authority. FINMA (1,133), SECO (Arbeitsgesetz 1,102 + AVIG-Praxis), ESTV (438), BAFU (297), SEM (Weisungen 92 + Handbuch), BSV (6,083, social insurance practice), BAG (38), BJ (debt enforcement), WEKO (Bekanntmachungen/Erläuterungen under the KG), OAK BV (BVG supervision: Weisungen, Mitteilungen). UEK (Takeover Board), RAB (audit oversight), EHRA (federal commercial register office), ESA (federal foundation supervision), BBSA / BSABB (foundation supervisors of Bern and of both Basel), MROS (money-laundering reporting office), SIF (State Secretariat for International Finance), Bankenombudsman (Swiss Banking Ombudsman), SBVg (Swiss Bankers Association). UN-* = the UN body that addressed the recommendation to Switzerland: UN-UPR (~1,450, Universal Periodic Review), UN-CAT (Committee against Torture), UN-CCPR (Human Rights Committee), UN-CESCR, UN-CERD, UN-CEDAW, UN-CRC, UN-CRPD, UN-CED, UN-SPT (Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture), UN-SPECIAL PROCEDURES (special rapporteurs, working groups).

language.description: OPTIONAL filter (de/fr/it; en for UN and some FINMA documents). Omit (recommended default) to search across all languages. Set ONLY when the user explicitly asks for one-language results.

query.description: Search query (FTS5 syntax: quotes for phrases, OR for alternatives, NEAR(term1 term2, N) for proximity).

source.description: Filter by source key. finma_rs (1,133), seco_arg (1,102), bafu_vollzug (297), estv_ks (285), estv_mwst (153), sem_weisungen (92), bsv_weisungen (BSV Wegleitungen/Kreisschreiben/Rundschreiben/Mitteilungen, every retained version, 6,083, DE/FR/IT), seco_alv (AVIG-Praxis ALE/KAE/SWE/RVEI/IE/AMM + thematic Weisungen, 54, DE/FR/IT), bag_kvg (KVG Kreisschreiben, 38, DE/FR), sem_handbuch_asyl (Handbuch Asyl und Rückkehr, 92 articles, DE/FR), bj_schkg (BJ Oberaufsicht SchKG: Weisungen, Informationen an die kantonalen Aufsichtsbehörden Nr. 1-24, model forms, the 2015 forms consultation, SchKG reports, plus cantonal and historical federal Kreisschreiben incl. older Existenzminimum-Richtlinien, DE/FR/IT), schkg_kantone (current publications of the cantonal SchKG supervisory authorities — Kreisschreiben/circulaires/circolari, Weisungen, the Existenzminimum guideline in force per canton, earlier editions via include_superseded — plus the KBKS national guidelines; authority = canton code or KBKS, DE/FR/IT), weko_bekanntmachungen (WEKO Bekanntmachungen + Erläuterungen, current and superseded versions, DE/FR/IT), oak_bv (OAK BV Weisungen W and Mitteilungen M, every version, Informationsschreiben/FAQ, Anhörungsentwürfe, DE/FR/IT), un_uhri (UN treaty-body, UPR and special-procedure recommendations and concerns addressed to Switzerland, from OHCHR's Universal Human Rights Index: one row per paragraph, ~3,350, EN/FR only — query in English or French; doc_number like 'CAT/C/CHE/CO/8, para. 9'; rows titled '[UHRI summary …]' are UHRI digests of pre-2012 reports, not the UN's words), un_gc (General Comments and General Recommendations of every UN treaty body — CCPR, CESCR, CAT, CERD, CEDAW, CRC, CRPD, CED, CMW, SPT — ~214 documents, FR and EN, doc_number = UN symbol, e.g. 'CAT/C/GC/4'; old ones under OHCHR's INT/ symbols), un_ch_translations (the federal offices' German translations of UN concluding observations on Switzerland — CAT 2010, CCPR 2009/2017, CESCR 2019, CERD 2021, CEDAW 2003/2022, CRC 2015/2021, SPT 2019; CRPD 2022 in Italian — not authoritative, doc_number = the UN symbol as in un_uhri), unhcr_country (UNHCR country guidance — International Protection Considerations, Eligibility Guidelines, Guidance Notes, Positions on Returns — every edition, EN plus UNHCR's DE/FR versions, for Afghanistan, Eritrea, Syria, Iraq, Sudan, Sri Lanka, Venezuela, Libya, Myanmar, Nigeria; one doc_number per country, so include_superseded gives the edition in force at the time), uek_rs (Übernahmekommission: UEK-Rundschreiben Nr. 1-5 with every revision, the repealed Rundschreiben and Mitteilungen, consultation drafts, the conflict-of-interest Richtlinie, Tätigkeitsberichte 2009-; DE/FR/IT/EN where translated; its rulings are search_decisions(court='uek')), rab_rs (Revisionsaufsichtsbehörde: RAB-RS 1/2007-1/2022, every version, Aufsichtsmitteilung 1-2022, Tätigkeits-/Geschäftsberichte; DE/FR/IT/EN), ehra (Eidg. Amt für das Handelsregister: Praxismitteilungen 1/2008- with Beilagen, Weisungen and Mitteilungen to the cantonal registers — Firmenrecht, FusG-Mustertexte, Sacheinlage; DE/FR/IT), finma_aufsicht (FINMA-Aufsichtsmitteilungen 2017- and the older FINMA-Mitteilungen incl. withdrawn ones, every language; plus doc_type rechtsprechung = the Bulletin 'Ausgewählte Verfügungen' 2010-2017, anonymised FINMA rulings in their original language; the Enforcementberichte 2014-2018; the annual reports 2008- (with the 2008 reports of EBK, BPV and Kst GwG); the licensing Wegleitungen, FAQ and Faktenblätter; DE/FR/IT/EN as published), stiftungsaufsicht (foundation supervision: ESA FAQ — one row per question, DE/FR/IT — model statutes and compensation regulations, annual reviews; BBSA Rundschreiben 2013- and Merkblätter, DE/FR; BSABB Merkblätter, model deeds, checklists, a 2019 legal opinion), hr_kantone (cantonal commercial registers: GE Notes aux notaires 2016-, VD note on its LFAIE practice, BE Merkblätter per legal form DE/FR; authority = canton code), mros (MROS money-laundering reporting office: annual reports 2015-, typologies, guides, sanctions alerts, sectoral risk assessments; DE/FR/IT/EN), estv_aia (ESTV: AIA/CRS and CbCR Wegleitungen, AIA FAQ, FATCA guidance; DE/FR/IT, EN where published), sif (SIF: national risk assessment reports on money laundering and terrorist financing 2017-2024, AIA explanatory notes), bankingombudsman (Swiss Banking Ombudsman: annual reports 2013-, case examples (doc_type rechtsprechung), position papers, press releases; DE/FR/IT/EN; private body, texts are the foundation's), sbvg (Swiss Bankers Association self-regulation: VSB/CDB 20 and 27 with commentaries, the VSB supervisory commission's Leading Cases, its activity reports, the mortgage and ESG Richtlinien, the list of all SBVg Richtlinien; private body; Richtlinien published only to members are not included).
